summary.text: Mary Carlson is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An entrepreneur and school board member, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is the DFL-endorsed candidate.

paragraphs.text: Mary Carlson earned a bachelor's degree from Gustavus Adolphus College in 2010, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including work as an entrepreneur.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she owns two event-based businesses that employ nine people and serves on the Carlton-Wrenshall School Board, where she was chair during the school district consolidation.
Carlson listed her top legislative priorities as property tax relief, a moratorium on hyperscale data center development while local ordinances are put in place, and boosting local economies.
She also said she supports prosecuting those who commit fraud against taxpayers and fully supports the 2026 legislation creating an Office of Inspector General.
